details:
I'm gonna try to not repeat what has already been said a million times.
I believe it's impossible to please everyone.
I think the development team should not strive to add most if not all features people wanted from mods, especially for the smug reason of "we can just do better".
Some communities or people will be inevitably left behind.
If VRChat wants to keep the majority of people secure then they shouldn't care what I do in my private instance alone, or with a friend or two.
I don't want them to decide how far I can fly my camera drone or how big or small I can make my avatar if I'm in private.
This is especially an issue if I'm doing something like filmmaking. What if I want to fly my drone across an entire world? I can't do that because of an arbitrary restriction that doesn't mean anything in private.
I don't expect much but propose a compromise:
Add an insecure launch option that launches the game without EAC and ONLY allows you to launch private instances which only people who are also in insecure mode can join.
This way people can do whatever the heck they want to their game in private and be kept completely separate from the rest of the game.
Valve games have this option and completely disable VAC if you do it. You can cheat, you can inject filmmaking mods into the engine, they don't care, you can do it. But if you try to join a secure server, you'll just not be allowed.
Now why would I want this? As stated before, filmmaking is one example! There was a mod called freeze frame that let you record yourself and create local clones that would play back your movements on loop forever. 
This basically meant you could have an infinite amount of actors all played by you! And you can also play the camera man, while your clones do everything.
This was way better and simpler than any kind janky udon implementation you could suggest as an alterative and worked in any world.
This would never make it into the game otherwise and would be a waste of development time to even consider.
Please don't preach the ToS like dogma if you don't have anything constructive to comment.
title: Add a private insecure mode similar to how Valve games have it
